name: ai-ledger-android
description: AI multifunction assistant Android App built with Capacitor.

scripts.android:init: npm install && npm run copy:web && npx cap add android && npm run android:install-plugin
scripts.android:sync: npm run copy:web && npx cap sync android && npm run android:install-plugin
scripts.android:install-plugin: node scripts/install-mobile-assistant-plugin.js && node scripts/patch-navigation-provider.js && npm run android:install-icon
